title: Top Navy Admiral: “The Ocean is FULL OF UFOs!”
description:
Our American Alchemist this week is Rear Admiral Tim Gallaudet (ret.), former acting administrator of NOAA and the Navy's de facto chief oceanographer , and the only flag officer on record who has spoken publicly about seeing the GoFast video on a classified Navy network.

Support Tim and check out his book below: 
"Holding Fast in Heavy Seas"

Rear Admiral Tim Gallaudet (ret.) served as Superintendent of the Naval Observatory, Acting Administrator of NOAA, and is now a member of the UAP Science Advisory Council reporting to the ODNI. In this conversation, he discloses publicly for the first time: a classified email from a female Navy commander documenting UAP tracking across five to seven ocean hotspots worldwide (likely the source of Tim Burchett's "alien bases" claim); a classified Navy dive unit that experiments with liquid oxygen breathing , the same units Eric Davis says conduct crash retrievals in the ocean; the existence of NURO (National Underwater Reconnaissance Office), so classified even the Navy's chief oceanographer had no read-in; his personal conviction that something anomalous was recovered from the 1962 Bluegill Triple Prime nuclear test; and details of an active Atlantis search involving Victor Vescovo, physicist Max Derakhshani, and proprietary bathymetry data , with a potential deep-sea expedition imminent.
